verification: Run staged gate and commit-msg checks; reconcile Git ledger and review rationale, risks and exclusions.
rule: Each commit must let a reviewer understand the problem, the solution, every changed file, the evidence that it works, important tradeoffs, and remaining work without reconstructing a chat. Detailed explanations supplement the diff; they must not contradict it or replace code review.

verification: Run staged gate and commit-msg checks; reconcile Git ledger and review rationale, risks and exclusions.
rule: The project policy is **no commit with a failed, blocked, missing, stale, or skipped required check**. This is stronger than merely requiring green checks before merging. Local hooks can be bypassed by Git options or configuration; they are useful controls, not an absolute security boundary. Remote CI and protected branches provide a second enforcement layer once hosting exists. Their existence alone does not validate local commits before creation. [Git hooks](https://git-scm.com/docs/githooks), [GitHub branch protection](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-protected-branches/about-protected-branches).

rule: - Commit one coherent, complete purpose at a time. Keep supporting tests, docs, migrations, and dependency changes with the behavior they support. Split unrelated cleanup or features into independently valid commits.

verification: Run staged gate and commit-msg checks; reconcile Git ledger and review rationale, risks and exclusions.
rule: - Explain the concrete before/after behavior and why it matters. Describe mechanisms and tradeoffs precisely; avoid vague statements such as "improve code," "various fixes," or "production-ready."

verification: Run staged gate and commit-msg checks; reconcile Git ledger and review rationale, risks and exclusions.
rule: - Write direct, natural engineering prose. No mentions of AI, models, assistants, prompting, generated-by signatures, or tool-credit boilerplate in commit messages. verification: Run staged gate and commit-msg checks; reconcile Git ledger and review rationale, risks and exclusions.

Do not invent attribution or sign-off trailers.

rule: For an amend, compare the final candidate tree against the original commit's first parent, not against the commit being amended; regenerate the **entire replacement message**, not only the new delta. An amended root commit uses the empty tree. For a merge commit, declare first-parent comparison and distinguish incoming changes from conflict resolutions; retain other parent IDs in evidence. A squash commit gets a fresh ledger against its actual target parent. Do not concatenate obsolete messages/counts. After rebase/cherry-pick/conflict resolution, regenerate evidence for the new candidate tree and parent.
